name: nextkey
description: Hand over secrets by ENS name, released by rules an enclave evaluates, opened only by the person you named.

scripts.build:bundles: esbuild web/src/app.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2022 --outfile=web/app.js && esbuild web/src/send.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2022 --outfile=web/send.js && esbuild web/src/explorer.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2022 --outfile=web/explorer.js && esbuild web/src/blog.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2022 --outfile=web/blog.js && esbuild web/src/donate.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2022 --outfile=web/donate.js && esbuild web/src/sandbox.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2022 --outfile=web/sandbox.js
scripts.api:dev: npm run build:api && npx --yes wrangler@4 dev -c api/wrangler.toml
scripts.api:deploy: npm run build:api && npx --yes wrangler@4 deploy -c api/wrangler.toml
scripts.test: npm run test:crypto && npm run test:pages
scripts.test:pages: node web/test/playground.mjs && node web/test/feed.mjs && node web/test/blog.mjs && node web/test/donate.mjs && node web/test/legal.mjs && node web/test/sandbox.mjs
